final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio Financeiro should behave as a local investment desk: the user gives Bob a mandate, CASE opens, data/math/Genie/Deep/committee/Trinity/guardrails/history run, Bob decides, paper/live gates execute, and the journal/feedback loop calibrates future decisions.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 and future operators who need a disciplined, auditable AI trading desk capable of multi-day supervised paper operation before real-money escalation.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Open the cockpit, submit a mandate or click a signal, watch the CASE progress through required evidence stages, review Bob's verdict/order, then let paper trades feed the journal and learning cycle.
final_objective.start_command: $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; python -m agent_server.main with llama-server on 8082 and TWS paper on 7497
final_objective.proof_output: A ready CASE system is proven by live traces where trade_order/investment_analysis cases automatically collect data or scan, run MathHub, six experts, Trinity, guardrails, final verdict, one broker path, journal entry, and later learning-cycle update.

evidence.commit_reviewed: d05fa2d feat: CASE — contrato financeiro obrigatorio, mesa estuda antes do Bob decidir
tests: Failure: test_pipeline_stream_events_blocks_unscoped_ticket_reference expected respond_blocked before agent; passthrough still routes to agent.
case_classifier_probe: create_case('comprar 10 NOK limite $5', ticker='') returned casual because the message is lowercased before uppercase ticker detection.
create_case('comprar 10 NOK limite $5', ticker='NOK') returned trade_order.

risks: CASE is currently a context/checklist layer, not an executable gate. It does not yet drive collection, expert execution, Trinity completion, verdict marking, or paper-order completion.
Trade-order CASE required_steps includes paper_order before verdict completion, which can make the case impossible to complete for WAIT/REJECT decisions.
mark_error currently completes a step, so a failed data provider could make a CASE appear complete instead of blocked/degraded.
Ticker detection inside create_case is broken for ticker-less payloads because uppercase detection runs after lowercasing the message.
The old auto_execute_paper parser path still exists beside submit_paper_order, so broker execution is not yet a single CASE-owned path.
Autopilot for days is not implemented: there is no resilient scheduler/daemon that monitors TWS, open positions, stop/exit logic, periodic case review, post-mortem, and learning-cycle execution.
next_step: Convert CASE from checklist to controller: typed case classifier, force_auto_collect/market stack from case type, explicit step semantics (ok/degraded/blocked/skipped), CASE-owned broker path, scheduler loop, position monitor, and learning-cycle automation.
